summary: 7-day streak snapped — hot CPI +0.9% MoM on energy costs. Dow -0.56%, S&P -0.11%, Nasdaq +0.35% (TSMC +35% Q1). VIX holds sub-20 at 19.23. Regime still Risk-On. Trump threatens Iran. Vance to Islamabad for weekend talks. PPI Tuesday, GS earnings Monday. BTC $72.8K pressing $73K resistance.

risks.label: CPI March Full Release (Monday)
risks.detail: Flash MoM +0.9% on energy surge. Full release Monday with YoY expected 3.4-3.6%. Core CPI 0.3% MoM would confirm transitory. Above 0.4% core = rate cut repricing.

risks.label: Iran — Trump Threatens Military Action
risks.detail: Trump accused Iran of 'very poor job' reopening Hormuz. Threatened military action if Islamabad talks fail. USS Gerald Ford in Gulf of Oman. Ceasefire officially 'fragile.'

risks.label: Hormuz Still <10% Traffic
risks.detail: Day 4 of ceasefire but only 7-15 ships/day vs 138 normal. IRGC controlling all passage via Larak Island. 800+ vessels stranded. Iran demanding crypto toll payments.

risks.label: Consumer Sentiment Record Low
risks.detail: UM Consumer Sentiment Index hit record low. 12-month inflation expectations surging. Consumers already behaving as if second inflation wave is real.

risks.label: HYG Credit Spreads Widening
risks.detail: HYG -0.40% — credit spreads widening while equities drop. Confirms selling is real, not just profit-taking. Watch early next week for recovery.

risks.label: Software Sector Crash -5%
risks.detail: Software Applications -5%, Staffing -4%, Diagnostics -4%. Rotation from defensive cloud/SaaS into cyclicals continues aggressively.

risks.label: China Taiwan Rhetoric
risks.detail: Xi told Taiwan opposition leader unification is 'inevitable.' Low probability but tail risk for semis supply chain.

events.label: Islamabad Peace Talks (This Weekend)
events.detail: VP Vance leading US delegation. Pakistan PM hosting. Iran's 10-point plan includes sanctions relief, Hormuz control, enrichment. Framework agreement = oil <$90.

events.label: GS Earnings (Monday Pre-Market)
events.detail: Goldman Sachs $16.32 EPS estimate. Sets tone for bank earnings week. Trading revenue likely strong on Iran volatility.

events.label: PPI March (Tuesday Apr 14)
events.detail: Producer Price Index confirms or denies transitory inflation thesis. Previous +0.7% MoM, +3.4% YoY.

events.label: Bank Earnings Week (Tue-Wed)
events.detail: JPM, WFC, BLK Tuesday. Elevated trading volumes should boost IB revenue but loan loss provisions for Iran war impact in focus.

events.label: China Q1 GDP (Apr 16)
events.detail: Consensus +4.8% YoY. Miss below 4.5% triggers PBOC easing. Beat above 5.0% validates Beijing stimulus.

events.label: EU-US Trade Deal Advancing
events.detail: European Parliament voted to advance ratification. 15% EU levy on US industrials in exchange for zero tariffs on EU exports. Steel/aluminum tiered duties announced.

opportunities.label: META — Breakout $629 (Scanner Apr 13)
opportunities.detail: Scanner Monday top pick. Score 92. Entry $629, Stop $603, TP1 $662, TP2 $698. R:R 1:1.7. Breakout strategy dominating regime transition.

opportunities.label: AMZN — Momentum $238 (Scanner Apr 13)

opportunities.detail: Financials -1% on CPI fear creates entry ahead of bank earnings. Steepening yield curve = NIM tailwind. Entry $48.50-49.50, TP1 $52.

opportunities.detail: Asia exposure on semis leadership. Score 91. Entry $371, Stop $353, TP1 $392, TP2 $410. R:R 1:1.6.

opportunities.label: Copper +2.11% — Green Energy + China
opportunities.detail: Copper rallied to $5.89/lb on China demand anticipation and green energy infra. Strongest commodity of the day.

regimes.label: Regime: Risk-On (Score 0.42)
regimes.detail: VIX 19.23 maxes out risk-on component. Credit slightly negative (HYG widening). SPX, liquidity, DXY all neutral. Regime holds despite CPI shock.

regimes.label: 7-Day Streak Ended — Healthy Pullback?
regimes.detail: S&P -0.11%, Dow -0.56% on CPI shock. Nasdaq held green +0.35%. VIX stayed sub-20. Pullback after 8% rally is normal. Key: does it resume next week?

regimes.label: Inflation Regime: Moderate/Stable
regimes.detail: TIP ETF $111.02 (+0.05%). Market treating CPI spike as energy-driven, transitory. Core CPI expected +0.3% MoM = not broad-based.

regimes.label: Tech > Value Rotation on CPI Days
regimes.detail: Nasdaq outperformed Dow by 91bp. Tech insulated from energy costs. Growth/AI names preferred when inflation is sector-specific.
